dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Distinct concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a falcate profile, with a deepening spline towards the lower third of the fin boundary.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded geometry at the apex with a moderate pixel radius; classified as rounded-obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis, characterized by a smooth convex arc starting from the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio of maximum vertical pixel height to maximum pixel base width at the dorsal ridge interface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of small irregularities and minor notches on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; subtle vertical linear striations visible on the main body flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, pale punctate markings visible across the lateral body surface.
